notes.text: The datasheet gives no absolute maximum ratings and no input logic levels (VIH/VIL); level checks against the ESP32 stay not_checked.

Green HX711 breakouts carry the S8550 regulator transistor, R1/R2 for AVDD ≈ 4.3 V and a crystal-less oscillator; header pins are VCC/GND/DT/SCK and E+/E−/A−/A+/B−/B+. Many boards tie VSUP, AVDD and DVDD together, so DOUT then swings to VCC.
